jobs.title: Director Business Applications (HCM & AI)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Dexterra Group
is a fast-growing, financially strong, publicly listed company (TSX:DXT). We have a far-reaching presence across the entire continent North America with hundreds of full-time and part-time opportunities at any given time. We aim to provide our people with more than just a job – we offer fulfilling opportunities in a culture that promotes stability, diversity and inclusion, camaraderie, employee recognition, work-life balance, and doing what you love. For over 75 years, the companies that began independently, and now form Dexterra Group, have been dedicated to serving North American clients to create and manage built environments that play a vital role in our economy and our local communities.

That’s something we’re truly proud of, Work That Matters, People Who Care
.

Job Description

We're looking for a strategic and business-focused Director, Business Applications
to lead the vision, governance, and evolution of our enterprise application ecosystem.

What's The Role?

The Director Business Applications
will lead the platforms that support Dexterra's operations and continued growth, operational excellence, and acquisition strategy.

From our HCM ( Dayforce)
and enterprise applications to AI
-enabled solutions and system integration initiatives, you'll help shape how technology delivers value
across the organization while driving digital transformation
, automation
, and scalable business processes.

What You'll Do

Developing and executing the roadmap for Dayforce and other enterprise business applications.
Leading application implementations, integrations, upgrades, and business process transformation initiatives.
Identifying and scaling AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, employee experience, and operational efficiency.
Partnering with leaders across HR, Finance, Operations, and IT to deliver technology solutions aligned with business priorities.
Driving application governance, risk management, compliance, change management, and operational excellence.
Supporting acquisition growth through application due diligence, integration planning, and system consolidation activities.
Managing strategic vendor relationships, technology investments, and platform performance.
Building and developing a high-performing business applications team focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

You are a collaborative technology leader with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale business applications and digital transformation initiatives. You understand how to translate business priorities into scalable technology solutions and are passionate about driving measurable business value.

Qualifications

A post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in enterprise applications, digital transformation, or technology-enabled operations.
Experience leading large-scale enterprise application environments, including implementation, optimization, governance, and ongoing support.
Strong knowledge of enterprise HCM/WFM platforms such as Dayforce, including roadmap planning, stakeholder governance, release management, and operational accountability.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, HR, Operations, and IT stakeholders.
Strong vendor management, budgeting, governance, and executive stakeholder engagement experience.
Experience with AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, or enterprise innovation programs is considered an asset.
Project Management, Service Management, or related certifications are considered an asset.

Additional Information

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Be part of an industry that's more important than ever!
Award winning safety culture.
A flexible hybrid work model.
Supportive team environment with room to grow together.
Employee Referral Program.
We are growing!
Certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026!

Dexterra Group
is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans’ status, Indigenous status, or any other legally protected factors. Accommodation is available upon request at all stages of the selection process.

We thank all applicants for their interest and will contact those candidates selected for interview.

Note, we are not accepting candidates from recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Reporting directly to the CEO, the CTO will lead the company’s technology strategy, engineering organization, product development, and adoption of engineering automation and applied AI. The role combines executive technology leadership with strong hands-on engineering judgement across software, embedded systems, electronics and hardware/software integration. The CTO will establish the company’s technical architecture and roadmap, maintain a sustainable engineering foundation and technology capability, lead complex international programs, and support demanding customers and manufacturing activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Define and maintain the company’s technology architecture, product roadmap and engineering priorities with the CEO; lead technology-selection decisions, establish technical standards, prepare engineering resource and budget plans, and manage approved resources within delegated authority.
Lead and develop the existing engineering organization, including recruitment as required, technical ownership, people development, performance management and resource allocation; maintain a scalable technical foundation and organizational capability to support current products and future growth.
Lead complex software, electronics and embedded-product programs across distributed and cross-functional teams, covering product definition, feasibility, architecture, development, integration, validation, release, manufacturing support and lifecycle maintenance.
Provide technical leadership for embedded and hardware/software co-development, including STM32 and comparable MCUs, FPGA-based systems, ARM/SoC platforms, board-level design and integration, component and peripheral selection, low-level software, device drivers/HAL, system bring-up, debugging and production issue resolution.
Lead sustained technical engagement with Mandarin-speaking customers, manufacturing operations and engineering partners, including requirements analysis, design reviews, tailored solution development, factory and system integration, project coordination, technical escalation and major issue resolution.
Lead engineering automation and applied-AI initiatives that improve development efficiency, quality and product value, including evaluation and integration of modern AI/agent technologies with appropriate validation, security, reliability controls and human oversight.
Establish project-management, development-process, quality-control and technical-risk practices appropriate for complex commercial products; monitor delivery commitments and report progress, significant risks, resource requirements and technology investment needs to the CEO.
Participate in international customer, partner, factory and project-site activities as required, including technical assessment, integration, project delivery and support.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

A master’s degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related engineering or technical discipline.
At least 15 years of technology and product-development experience in software, embedded systems, semiconductors, intelligent systems, industrial technology, automotive electronics, mobile platforms or related fields, including substantial responsibility in large-scale, cross-functional and internationally distributed R&D environments.
At least 6 years of technology-management experience with responsibility for multidisciplinary engineering teams. Demonstrated experience building or substantially scaling an engineering organization and establishing effective technical ownership, people-development, accountability and resource-management mechanisms.
A sustained record of leading large and technically complex programs across countries, time zones and engineering disciplines, with responsibility for architecture, delivery, quality and technical risk.
Strong embedded and systems-engineering background, including Linux, processor/SoC/MCU platforms, hardware/software integration, low-level interfaces, device drivers/HAL and system debugging; ability to lead architecture reviews and make sound trade-offs across performance, reliability, cost and maintainability.
Experience delivering and supporting demanding international customer programs, translating complex requirements into practical and customized technical solutions, and leading major technical issue resolution; strong understanding of mature project-management, development-process, quality-control and release practices.
Practical experience applying modern AI-assisted development and/or agent technologies to real engineering or product-development workflows, including integration, validation, effectiveness assessment and appropriate human oversight.
Advanced professional English sufficient to independently lead international technical and business meetings, architecture and solution discussions, customer coordination and professional documentation; approximately CEFR C1 level or equivalent.
Professional working proficiency in Mandarin sufficient to independently conduct technical requirements discussions, design reviews, project coordination, factory/system integration, technical escalation and complex issue resolution with Mandarin-speaking customers, manufacturing operations and engineering partners.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Interdisciplinary expertise combining electrical/electronic engineering with intelligent systems, automation, computing or AI.
Broad hands-on embedded/software experience involving ARM platforms, STM32 or comparable MCUs, FPGA-based systems, board/peripheral integration, JTAG/SWD, TRACE32 or comparable professional embedded-debug environments, together with experience integrating and maintaining open-source or third-party software in commercial products.
Experience in automotive electronics, mobile computing, semiconductor platforms, industrial/manufacturing systems or marine-related technologies; multimedia, audio/video, DSP or graphics expertise is an advantage.
Advanced AI engineering experience involving coding agents, engineering toolchain/workflow integration, reliability and security controls, performance optimization and organization-wide adoption.
Engineering-management experience in a large international technology company, with exposure to mature global project-management, quality-control and customer-delivery practices.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your résumé to： jessicaqu@xtronica.net
